fit_reason: A private owner is selling a whole truck: a 1991 Isuzu NPR rollback. The VW Beetle sitting on the bed in one photo is not part of the sale.
findings: Red cab paint looks dull and faded on the passenger side and door
Grime and dirt on the hydraulic bed control levers and their mounting tray
Dirty, cluttered side toolbox with rags, papers and chains stuffed inside
Dirt and grime on the frame and winch area behind the cab
Weathered, dull finish on the aluminum rollback bed deck
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Isuzu NPR rollback. The red cab looks a bit faded in the photos, and the control levers and toolbox area are pretty grimy. We do mobile pre-sale washes and paint buffs and can come to you to help the truck present better to buyers. Would you like a quote?
